translations.web: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
translations.bsb: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
translations.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
